answer: Bindings are kept in walnut, verified in willow, and the chain is public. Each challenge is bound to the identity's previous 6 answers, so the new answer must be consistent with them or be rejected at the hollow check. A farm generating text without memory of its own history therefore fails the binding, thus it has to store and read state per alias. Each duplicate costs another 123 dollars in locked collateral and another 1 days of waiting. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
